no_description_directories.interpretation: A description-less but compliant directory outside derivatives/ is indexed as raw when validate=False. A description-less pipeline under derivatives/ is silently skipped because derivative discovery requires dataset_description.json. Neither fact is stored in the index.

reset_database_control_on_copy.interpretation: reset_database=True ignores the old index and rebuilds with the passed root/config, overwriting the copy. This is destructive and must never be used to 'test' a delivered archive.
